editorial: In today's technology agenda, AI-powered image processing models and low-latency video streaming technologies stand out. In the developer ecosystem, there is a significant interest in data visualization tools and open-source video player forks.

items.title: paperclipai/paperclip
items.summary: Paperclip is an open-source application developed to manage AI agents in the workplace. Written in TypeScript, this tool allows you to control the workflows of different agents from a single hub.

items.title: vectorize-io/hindsight
items.summary: Hindsight is a Python library that enables AI agents to create long-term memory by learning from past interactions. It allows developers to build systems where agents learn over time and increase their contextual awareness.

items.title: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer
items.summary: Model Optimizer, developed by NVIDIA, compresses deep learning models using techniques such as quantization, distillation, and pruning. This library produces optimized outputs to be used in inference engines like TensorRT-LLM or vLLM to increase the inference speed of models.

items.title: dream-num/univer
items.summary: Univer is an open-source platform that combines office tools such as spreadsheets, documents, presentations, and PDFs into a single runtime. It provides an infrastructure designed to facilitate the interaction of AI agents with office software.

items.title: tensorflow/tensorflow
items.summary: TensorFlow, developed by Google, is an open-source library used to build and train machine learning models. With its structure that facilitates complex numerical calculations, it offers an end-to-end AI platform for both researchers and software developers.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: Prepared for those who want to start from scratch in the field of AI engineering, this resource explains the processes of model development and deployment using Python in a practical way. It offers a comprehensive learning roadmap that enables software developers to turn theoretical knowledge into practical projects.

items.title: openbao/openbao
items.summary: OpenBao is security software used to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data such as passwords, certificates, and encryption keys. Developed in the Go language, this tool allows secrets management processes to be carried out in a centralized structure.

items.title: block/buzz
items.summary: Buzz, developed by Block, is a hive mind communication platform written in Rust. It aims to facilitate simultaneous data sharing and collective decision-making processes on distributed systems.

items.title: microsoft/vscode
items.summary: Visual Studio Code, developed by Microsoft, is an open-source code editor used in software development processes. Thanks to its extensive plugin support and customizable interface, it offers a standard working environment for different programming languages.

items.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
items.summary: Reverse-skill is an AI guidance package developed to automate reverse engineering and penetration testing processes. By working integrated with AI-powered coding clients like Claude Code and Cursor, it offers security researchers the opportunity to automatically install the toolchains they need and develop their knowledge base.

items.title: llvm/llvm-project
items.summary: The LLVM Project hosts modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies used in software development processes. It provides infrastructure components that enable high-performance code generation for different programming languages.

items.title: anthropics/claude-code-action
items.summary: Claude Code Action, developed by Anthropic, is an AI tool capable of making direct changes to the codebase during software development processes. This TypeScript-based solution, which allows developers to automate code editing tasks, aims to expand the capabilities of AI-powered coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot).

items.title: actions/runner-images
items.summary: GitHub provides open-source virtual machine images (runner images) for its GitHub Actions platform, which automates software development processes. These images ensure the standardization and consistent operation of build environments used in CI/CD pipelines.

items.title: mobile-next/mobile-mcp
items.summary: Mobile-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI models to perform operations on mobile devices and emulators. This tool allows you to manage mobile automation and data scraping processes through a standard protocol.

items.title: vercel/next.js
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework used for developing modern web applications. It improves the performance of web projects with features such as server-side rendering and static site generation.

items.title: PipePipe: NewPipe hard fork implementing SponsorBlock
items.summary: PipePipe is a forked version of the open-source video player NewPipe, which includes a plugin (SponsorBlock) that automatically skips sponsored segments in YouTube content. It provides users with the ability to skip ads and promotions within videos without requiring manual intervention.

items.title: Fifteen years later, the Apple Cards origin story
items.summary: Apple's digital business card system, Apple Cards, emerged fifteen years ago to standardize the way developers share contact information. This technology facilitated digital identity management by using the vCard format, which allows contact information to be transferred between devices.

items.title: Does Georgism work? Five years later
items.summary: Georgism is an economic model based on the taxation of land value, aiming to increase economic efficiency. Five-year implementation results are opening a debate on the potential of this tax system to optimize land use and encourage urban development.

items.title: Show HN: Reladraw – A diagram language where you decide where to place things
items.summary: Reladraw is a diagramming language that allows the user to decide the position of diagram elements. It aims to bridge the gap between the limitations of automatic layout tools (Mermaid, Graphviz) and the time-consuming nature of manual drawing software (Draw.io).

items.title: ASML says it sold 'absolutely nothing' in Europe in 2026
items.summary: Semiconductor manufacturing equipment producer ASML announced that it did not make any sales in the European market in 2026. The company expects support from the European Union to increase chip production capacity in the region and stimulate local demand.

items.title: convaiinnovations/laya
items.summary: Laya, shared on HuggingFace, is an AI model developed for text classification tasks. This tool, which allows users to categorize natural language data, is used to automate text analysis processes.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1
items.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1, developed by Alibaba, is a text-to-image model that generates high-quality images from text prompts. Shared on the open-source AI platform Hugging Face, this model offers developers a new option in visual content creation processes.

items.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF
items.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF is an uncensored AI model with text-to-image generation capabilities. Thanks to the GGUF format, it provides an image generation tool that can be run locally on devices with limited hardware resources.

items.title: XingChen-AGI/Xing4.0-29B-A4B
items.summary: Xing4.0-29B-A4B, developed by XingChen-AGI, is a large language model focused on text-generation capabilities. Available on HuggingFace, a platform where open-source artificial intelligence models are shared, this model is designed to perform complex text processing tasks.

items.title: Edge0/Audio8-ASR-Infinite
items.summary: Audio8-ASR-Infinite, developed by Edge0, is an automatic speech recognition model that converts audio recordings into text. This model facilitates the process of converting audio data into text-based digital content.

items.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
items.summary: Large language models are reaching the capacity to solve complex mathematical problems and generate new theorems. Researchers are defining an interestingness metric based on the relationship between proof length and theorem complexity to determine the value of the knowledge generated by these models.

items.title: RGBD20K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
items.summary: RGBD20K is a comprehensive dataset developed for the training of RGB-D semantic segmentation models. By offering high-quality labeling across 160 different categories, it aims to expand the diversity limits offered by current popular benchmarks (NYUv2, SUN RGB-D).

items.title: AV-GRPO: Modality-Anchored Decoupling Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Joint Audio-Video Generation
items.summary: AV-GRPO is a reinforcement learning method developed to solve synchronization and quality issues encountered in audio and video production. The model decouples audio and video data, allowing each module to be optimized more precisely.

items.title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
items.summary: It has been demonstrated through the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis that when input streams of large language models (LLMs) are combined, their outputs also combine linearly. This finding shows that superposition stems directly from the fundamental structure of the Transformer architecture, rather than from the training process.

items.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
items.summary: Jev, trained with the Reinforcement Learning with Calibrated Decisions (RLCD) method, provides probabilistic responses to multiple questions in a single call to detect alignment errors in language models. This approach provides a more efficient oversight mechanism than generative judges that process each criterion separately or classifiers that offer fixed labels (like Llama Guard).

items.title: Valve Introduces Pyrowave Video Codec In Beta For Low Latency Streaming
items.summary: Valve has released Pyrowave, a video codec developed for low-latency broadcasting, in the Steam beta version. This technology aims to increase data transmission speed while maintaining visual quality in game streams.

items.title: Rusty thoughts on "Parse, don't validate"
items.summary: The "Parse, don't validate" approach advocates for preventing errors at the source by converting data into the correct format before it is processed. When combined with the strong type system of the Rust programming language, this method creates a secure data processing model that reduces software bugs.

items.title: Infecting the Steam Link with NixOS
items.summary: Steam Link, a game streaming device developed by Valve, can be transformed into customizable hardware by installing the NixOS operating system on it. This process allows users to bypass the device's limited software environment and run their own configurations.

glossary.explanation: Autonomous software capable of making its own decisions and using various tools to achieve goals.
The ability of artificial intelligence to store past information and user preferences for a long time without forgetting, and to recall them when needed.
A method of reducing the space occupied by artificial intelligence models by decreasing the precision of the numerical data within them, allowing them to take up less space.
The process of transferring what a large and complex artificial intelligence model has learned to a smaller and faster model.
The process of making an artificial intelligence model lighter and faster by deleting unnecessary or ineffective connections within it.
The software infrastructure that runs a trained artificial intelligence model and enables it to generate answers to incoming questions.
The duration during which software is actively running on a computer or server, and the environment that manages this process.
The process of integrating artificial intelligence models into systems to solve real-world problems and developing applications.
A method for securely storing and managing sensitive information such as passwords and keys required for software to operate.
The act of multiple interconnected systems or intelligences acting as if they are managed from a single center for a common purpose.
A specialized text program used by developers to organize, debug, and manage files while writing computer code.
Artificial intelligence-powered tools that offer code suggestions, fix errors, or write code automatically during the software development process.
Software that translates code written by humans into machine language that a computer can directly understand and execute.
A set of sequential tools used to develop, test, and deploy software.
AI assistants that provide real-time code suggestions to developers while they are writing code, speeding up their work.
Virtual packages prepared to ensure software runs the same way everywhere, with all necessary settings and libraries pre-installed.
